inicio.descripcion: Get insurance quotes and manage your Open Finance consents.
inicio.error: We couldn't load your information. Please try again later.

consentimientos.descripcion: Control which financial data Solventa can use, for what and for how long.
consentimientos.queDatosDetalle: Only what each purpose states, reported by the institutions you choose under the Open Finance standard. It's used only while the consent is active, and you can revoke it at any time.
consentimientos.porVencer: Expires in {{count}} days. Renew it to keep getting personalized offers.

otorgar.autorizo: I authorize Solventa to consult my financial data from the selected institutions for the purpose “{{finalidad}}”, with the scope and validity described (legal text {{version}}).
otorgar.sinAutorizacion: You must check the authorization to continue.

consecuencia.cotizacion: Your next quotes will use the standard price, without your financial data.
consecuencia.suscripcion: We'll stop using your financial data to evaluate your policy applications.
consecuencia.prevencion_fraude: We'll stop using your financial data to verify your transactions.

revocar.propagacion: The revocation takes effect across the platform in less than 5 minutes.

errores.cargar: We couldn't load your consents. Please try again.
errores.consentimiento_ya_vigente: You already have an active consent for this purpose.
errores.consentimiento_no_vigente: This consent is no longer active.
errores.consentimiento_revocado: A revoked consent can't be renewed: grant it again.
errores.version_texto_desactualizada: The legal text changed. Reload the page to read the current version.
errores.entidades_invalidas: Select at least one valid institution.
errores.general: We couldn't complete the operation. Please try again.

cotizacion.descripcion: Get a personalized premium based on your risk profile.

producto.titulo: 1. Choose the product you want to quote

datos.valorAyuda: Plan amount: {{valor}}. Fill it in only if you want a different one.

openFinance.titulo: 3. Personalize your offer with Open Finance
openFinance.usarAyuda: We can offer you a more accurate premium based on your financial behavior.
openFinance.vigente: You have an active consent for quotes until {{fecha}}.
openFinance.sinConsentimiento: You don't have an active consent.
openFinance.sinConsentimientoDetalle: We'll quote with the standard price.
openFinance.openData: We include Open Data sources depending on the product: demographics, location and aggregated industry claims.

oferta.ahorro: You save {{ahorro}} a month compared to the standard price of {{estandar}}.

base.open_finance: Price calculated with your Open Finance profile. The result is explainable and auditable.
base.open_finance_en_cache: Your financial institution didn't respond in time, so we used your saved financial profile. The price is just as valid.

estandar.sin_consentimiento: We didn't use financial data because you don't have an active consent for quotes.
estandar.open_finance_desactivado: We didn't use financial data because you chose to quote without it.
